deferred_source_units.source_text: They will hide away all the handmade things,
deferred_source_units.reason: The supplied action is hiding away handmade things, not their abolition. No independently read counterpart was retained for this particular action; adjacent rejection-of-idols links do not complete this unit.

deferred_source_units.source_text: For a man will seize his brother or a member of his father’s household, saying, “You have a cloak; become our leader, and let my food be under you!”
deferred_source_units.reason: The demand that a relative become leader because he has a cloak, with the speaker's food put under him, has no sufficiently specific retained counterpart. A general request for a ruler would omit the defining clothes-and-food conditions.

deferred_source_units.source_text: Answering on that day, he will say, “I will not be your leader, for there is neither bread nor cloak in my house. I will not be leader of this people.”
deferred_source_units.reason: The refusal of leadership because the house has neither bread nor a cloak was read in its immediate exchange. No particular independent counterpart to this material basis for refusal was established.

deferred_source_units.source_text: the garments bordered with purple and those purple at the center,
deferred_source_units.reason: The removed garments are specifically purple-bordered and purple at the center. Available adornment passages did not establish these particular forms; the Revelation proposal could not be read at the pinned source and remains an unread hint.

deferred_source_units.source_text: the coverings used about the house and the transparent Laconian garments,
deferred_source_units.reason: Household coverings and transparent Laconian garments are particular items in the removal catalogue. No verified target specifically clarifies these items without turning the verse into a generic clothing link.

deferred_source_units.source_text: Seven women will take hold of one man, saying, “We will eat our own bread and put on our own clothes; only let your name be called over us. Take away our disgrace!”
deferred_source_units.reason: The seven women propose their own bread and clothing in exchange for one man's name and removal of disgrace. No supported counterpart to this arrangement was established, and a childlessness or fertility explanation was not imported.

deferred_source_units.source_text: They will not hunger or grow weary, slumber or sleep, nor loosen the belts from their waists; their sandal straps will certainly not break.
deferred_source_units.reason: The invading force's lack of hunger, fatigue, sleep, loosened belts, and broken sandal straps is unusually specific. General military-strength comparisons do not establish this combination, so no target was retained.

deferred_source_units.source_text: And the Lord spoke again to Achaz, saying,
deferred_source_units.reason: This unit introduces renewed divine speech to Achaz without yet giving its content. A generic divine-speech formula is insufficient to retain an independent connection.

deferred_source_units.source_text: and they will all come and rest in the country’s ravines, in holes of the rocks, in the caves, in every fissure and in every tree.
deferred_source_units.reason: The summoned swarm settles in ravines, rock holes, caves, every fissure, and every tree. No sufficiently particular independent swarm-settlement counterpart was established; the following and preceding invasion images do not supply one automatically.

deferred_source_units.source_text: On that day a person will raise a heifer from the cattle and two sheep,
deferred_source_units.reason: The exact husbandry description is a person raising a heifer and two sheep. The following milk-and-honey connection does not independently establish a target for these animals and quantities.

deferred_source_units.source_text: With missile and arrow they will enter there, because all the land will be fallow ground and thorn.
deferred_source_units.reason: Entering thorny fallow ground with missile and arrow is stated, but hunting is not. The read hunting proposal was not retained because it would add that purpose to the source.

deferred_source_units.source_text: The Lord spoke to me yet again,
deferred_source_units.reason: This is the introductory statement that the Lord spoke yet again. The forthcoming oracle is read, but a generic speech-introduction link would not give this individual unit a particular supported counterpart.

deferred_source_units.source_text: Thus says the Lord: “With a strong hand they resist the course of this people’s way, saying,
deferred_source_units.reason: The supplied plural action is that they resist the course of this people's way with a strong hand. It was not rewritten as the familiar command that Isaiah should not walk the people's way; no target was retained on that unsupported substitution.

deferred_source_units.source_text: For He gave law for help, so that they might speak unlike this utterance, concerning which there are no gifts to give for it.
deferred_source_units.reason: The supplied wording says law was given for help and speaks of an utterance with no gifts to give for it. Its particular formulation was not replaced by a familiar law-and-testimony or lack-of-dawn rendering, and no sufficiently grounded counterpart was retained.

deferred_source_units.source_text: A harsh famine will come upon you; when you hunger, you will be grieved and speak evil of the ruler and the cult images, and they will look up toward heaven above,
deferred_source_units.reason: The hungry people speak evil of the ruler and cult images, then look upward. No particular independent counterpart to that combination was established; the object of the cursing was not changed to God.
